notes: Campuses with a published power figure of 25 MW or more. This is not a full census. Operators such as AWS, Microsoft, Google, Meta and Equinix rarely publish power per site, so many of their campuses are missing, and mainland China, Taiwan, Latin America and the Gulf are thin. Power for an operational site is live load where a tracker measures it and the operator's design capacity otherwise, so treat it as an upper bound. Grey sites show planned full build-out. Tracker ranges are drawn at their lower bound. Crypto-only mines are left out.
